query: How do positions work on XOXNO Lending — is a position tied to my wallet address? Can I have more than one and can I let a bot manage it?
expected_behavior: Explains that positions are u64 account ids owned by whoever holds the position NFT (token id == account id), that one address can own many accounts, and that account_id 0 creates a new account
States that ownership moves with an NFT transfer immediately and that delegate grants made by the previous owner stop working (they are suspended, and only removed by remove_delegate)
Describes delegation as two-key: governance registers the delegate as an active position manager AND the NFT owner calls add_delegate; delegates cannot renew_account or manage delegates
Distinguishes owner-or-delegate verbs (borrow, withdraw, strategies) from permissionless repay and caller-only supply of already-supplied assets
Does not claim there is a collateral enable/disable toggle per position
